topic: How the Federal Reserve’s 1913 creation changed money supply

script.title: Federal Reserve 1913: How It Revolutionized the Money Supply
script.hook: What if the Fed is a 1913 money machine?

scenes.text: What if the Fed is a 1913 money machine?
Congress formed the Federal Reserve in 1913 to stop banking panics.
It gave the government authority to create money beyond gold reserves.
Money supply grew from roughly fifteen billion dollars then to over twenty trillion now.
That expansion fuels average inflation of about three percent each year.
When the Fed hikes rates, it can shrink that supply, sparking recessions.
